m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Oh, hey, Wizard! It's good to see your face. Though, your furrowed brow makes me feel like this isn't a social call. What's the matter, mate?
There's a dead Child of Raven in the Infirmary? Bummer. Oh, she's only <ITALICS>mostly</ITALICS> dead? Then she's slightly alive. I have just the thing!
This Vitality Bolus should help her stay tethered to the mortal plane. At least, I hope it will.
I need a moment to collect a few more things, but you should get that Bolus to the girl immediately! I'll meet you in the Infirmary.
Mellori's Divine spirit is being pulled away from her mortal form by an energy unlike any I've ever experienced. She's dying.
Whaaaaaaaaaaa!
Ugghh... No. So... bright...
She's putting up a strong fight, but her only hope is for someone to go to the Astral Plane and help her.
Impossible! The Astral Plane is the space between existence and nothingness. No one of the Spiral can enter the Astral Plane. She's doomed!
WHAAAAAAAA!
You're right, Qyburn. Spiral beings cannot enter the Astral plane. But the Wizard isn't from the Spiral. They're from Earth.
Whaaa... What?
This revelation is making me... confused. But there will be time for answers later. How does the Wizard get to the Astral plane, Zander?
I'm afraid I'm out of my depth on that one, but an Astral Portal would be a good start.
Oh! Oh! That's me! I can set up an Astral Portal, no problem. Everyone stand back.
This is going to rip a hole in space-time.
Valar juliannas marghulies!
It worked!
Hello? Mom... mommy... ugh...
Whaa! What are your waiting for, Wizard? Go through the Astral Portal! Save my girl!
You saw Mellori? Amongst great white nothingness? Uh huh. What else? Raven and Mellori are going to end the Spiral? Whaaaa!
I feel... scared. We should all take some time to process this information. There is much planning to be done.
Do not wander far, Understudy. The committee of Scholars will be calling for you very soon.
*GAAASP!* Bat! Ugh... muuh... eugh...
Whatever that was seems to have helped! Sort of.
It was a dose of pure Life energy. It should help stabilize her mortal body. But I can't speak to her divine Luminiferous Essence.
I need to perform a Theurgical examination. Everyone be quiet. Be absolutely still.
Well? Anything? Is my Mellori going to be alright?
Her body's suffered great trauma, but it's nothing we can't treat. I can't say the same for her Divine spirit. Wizard. I need to talk to you.
I don't care if I'm not her real mother. I raised that girl. She'll always be my daughter. Tell me, Wizard. Is my dear Mellori... dead?
She's only mostly dead. But that's as far as my medical knowledge extends. My backwater med school didn't have Semi-Divine Physiology 101.
*Whimper* Whaaaa!
Take Mellori to the Infirmary immediately! Wizard, go fetch Zander from the Hall of Theurgy. NOW!
